# Historical V3.1 packages

These are the previously local, unpushed V3.1 archives, retained for release history. They do not contain the newer configuration approval policy and are not the recommended update.

Use the complete current update under [releases/v3.2](../../releases/v3.2). The accepted moderator-facing handbook is [the searchable HTML](../../docs/Melee-Zone-Moderator-Manual.html) or [Word](../../docs/Melee-Zone-Moderator-Handbook.docx). The older HTML in this historical folder is an internal reference, not the approved handbook to distribute to moderators.
